_comment: Generic Codex identity seed. Installation creates local continuity; authority is issued by the Hestia daemon and is never shipped here.

substrate.local_footprint: runtime identity and observation files under the configured Codex home

mrh.out_of_scope_note: Request any required scope from the installation operator.
